_comment: Read only when ColorLight (an optional client mod) is installed. ColorLight's level for a block caps how bright it draws the block's light; this mod's client draws soul lights at 13 and lit candles at 6, 9, 12, 15 for 1 to 4 candles (a candle cake as one), so the caps for these are raised to match (ColorLightBrighter). The game's light level stays vanilla's.
